d: We are seeking an experienced FF&E Project Manager to lead the planning, procurement, coordination, delivery, installation, and close-out of furniture, fixtures, and equipment packages for complex projects. The role will ensure that FF&E solutions meet the approved design intent, operational requirements, project budget, quality standards, and applicable regulations.

The successful candidate will coordinate clients, designers, consultants, contractors, vendors, procurement teams, and site stakeholders throughout the FF&E lifecycle, proactively managing interfaces, risks, approvals, logistics, installation, snagging, and handover.
q: Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
Professional project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is preferred.
Relevant membership or certification in interior design, procurement, or construction management is an advantage.
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years managing FF&E packages on major projects.
Proven delivery experience across hospitality, residential, commercial, healthcare, education, cultural, or mixed-use developments.
Demonstrated experience in FF&E specifications, procurement, vendor management, cost control, logistics, installation, and handover.
Experience coordinating international suppliers, long-lead items, importation, warehousing, and phased site delivery.
Strong knowledge of material quality, fabrication methods, finishes, furniture construction, and installation standards.
Prior project experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC is strongly preferred; experience on large or fast-track developments is an advantage.
Comprehensive understanding of the FF&E lifecycle, from design development and specification through procurement, installation, and close-out.
Strong project planning, scheduling, budgeting, risk management, and contract administration capabilities.
Ability to assess samples, mock-ups, shop drawings, finishes, and technical submissions against specifications and design intent.
Commercial awareness and confidence in tender analysis, negotiation, value engineering, variations, and cost forecasting.
Excellent coordination, stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced project environment.
Proficiency in MS Office and project management software; familiarity with AutoCAD, BIM coordination platforms, ERP/procurement systems, and FF&E tracking tools is advantageous.

DAR Engineering is a leading multidisciplinary consultancy firm providing design, architecture, engineering, project management, construction management and planning services across a broad range of sectors. We assist national governments, international organizations, and private sector companies by delivering comprehensive solutions with global expertise.
To learn more about DAR, please visit www.dar-engineering.com

d: DeepLight AI is a specialist AI and data consultancy with extensive experience implementing intelligent enterprise systems across multiple industries, with particular depth in financial services and banking. Our team combines deep expertise in data science, statistical modeling, AI/ML technologies, workflow automation, and systems integration with a practical understanding of complex business operations.
The Regulatory Project Manager is responsible for overseeing core banking projects from inception to deployment.

The role is responsible for the full lifecycle of the project, using hybrid methodologies, and must ensure delivery is aligned with strategic business goals of the organisation. The role works closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact transformation projects The role combines strong technical understanding with exceptional project management skills and business acumen and requires deep domain and technical awareness to successfully navigate the system's complexity.. The Regulatory banking PM role is centered on managing the implementation, transformation, or upgrade of the bank's central IT systems, which are critical to all operations.
As the Regulatory Project Manager, your responsibilities will include;

Developing and managing comprehensive project plans, defining scope, objectives, deliverables, and milestones. This includes setting deadlines, managing the budget, and ensuring effective resource allocation.

Proactively identifying potential risks and issues (RAID - Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) specific to the banking domain (e.g., data loss, security breaches, compliance failure) and prepare detailed mitigation strategies.
Managing communication and expectations across a diverse, complex stakeholder group, including:
IT Teams, Architects, and Technical Leads
Monitoring and reporting project status, risks, and performance metrics to management. Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for auditability and governance.

Regulatory Compliance: ensuring the project design and implementation (including data integrity, security, and process flows) adhere strictly to local and international financial regulations (e.g., AML, KYC, FATCA, Basel III).
Coordinating the complex process of data migration, ensuring data integrity and zero information loss during the transition.
Establish clear migration pathways and contingency plans to prevent service disruptions.
Manage the interfaces and system integration with surrounding applications (e.g., wealth management, loan systems, digital channels).
Manage the relationship and contracts with the Core Banking System vendor, tracking their tasks, deliverables, and commitment to the project's success.

An understanding of the banking IT world, system design, databases (SQL), and API management (REST, SOAP) to effectively liaise with technical leads and investigate system logs or queries when necessary

Strong leadership to guide cross-functional teams (IT, Legal, Operations, Business) and clear, frequent communication to senior stakeholders.
A solid knowledge of banking products, processes, and the strategic rationale for the core banking change.
The ability to identify bottlenecks, troubleshoot issues in a high-stakes environment, and make quick, informed decisions to maintain business continuity.
Knowledge and understanding of how core banking transactions are performed
Understanding and experience of working within the SDLC framework
